primary_endpoint: Change in ALT and relative percent change in ALT from baseline to Day 28/early termination.
efficacy_outcome: At Day 28/early termination, ALT change was -37.8 U/L with IDN-6556 vs -14.9 U/L with placebo (p=0.0195). Relative percent change was -39.2% vs -13.9%, respectively (p-value not reported).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 1/19 participants in each group; deaths were not reported.
